en.title: A semantic layer is a team boundary
en.shortdesc: The report engine we built is not a technology decision — it is two teams joined by one API contract, and everything else follows from that line.
en.longdesc: Part 1 of a series on building a semantic-layer report engine: why reporting today is a manual pipeline, and how splitting the system into an app plane and an analytics plane joined by a single API contract dissolves the tickets, the drift and the stale decks.
en.seoTitle: A semantic layer is a team boundary
en.seoDescription: Why a semantic layer is first an organizational interface: two teams, one API contract. Part 1 of a series on building a governed report engine.
